steps.en: Serve the app locally (or just open the public instance)
steps.zh: 本地起应用（或直接开公共实例）

steps.en: Paste the unreadable blob into the input box
steps.zh: 把读不懂的数据粘进输入框

steps.en: Magic runs detection heuristics and offers a candidate decode chain
steps.zh: Magic 跑识别启发式，给出候选解码链

steps.en: Drag operations into the recipe to chain the transforms
steps.zh: 把操作拖进 recipe，串起变换链

steps.en: Auto Bake re-runs the whole chain and updates the output live, in your browser
steps.zh: Auto Bake 在浏览器里重跑整条链，输出实时刷新

steps.en: Copy the URL — the recipe serialises into it — to save or share
steps.zh: 复制 URL——recipe 序列化在里面——即可保存或分享

value.en: A reproducible, shareable transform pipeline that never sends your data to a server
value.zh: 一条可复现、可分享的变换流水线，数据从不出你的机器

sources: https://github.com/gchq/CyberChef README.md (fetched 2026-09-28): docker run -it -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/gchq/cyberchef:latest; four UI areas (input/output/operations/recipe); Magic 'automated encoding detection' with magic icon in the Output field; Auto Bake 'whenever you modify the input or the recipe, CyberChef will automatically bake'; deep linking format https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/#recipe=Operation()&input=...
